name: kernel-opt-agent
description: GPU kernel knowledge-base, benchmarking, profiling, and optimization-loop skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: GPU kernel KBS retrieval, benchmarking, NCU profiling, and optimization-loop workflows.
interface.longDescription: Installs kernel-KBS, kernel-benchmark, kernel-profile, and kernel-loop: a corpus-backed GPU kernel knowledge base, PyTorch-reference benchmarking for CUDA/CUTLASS/CuTe DSL/Triton kernels, local correctness and Nsight Compute profiling, plus an iterative bottleneck-driven optimization loop that chains profiling, KBS-guided hypotheses, one-change kernel iterations, and final reporting.
defaultPrompt: Search kernel-KBS for Blackwell NVFP4 GEMM patterns.
Benchmark this Triton kernel against a PyTorch reference.
Profile this Triton kernel and classify its bottleneck.
Find source-backed CUDA optimization ideas for this kernel.
Run an iterative optimization loop for this kernel with NCU evidence and a final report.
